message:
Elvera, as I say [here](/weblog/archives/2005/05/17/razor-wire-writing/), the thanks are due to you and your research skills and persistence far more than they are to me. You and Danielle Cathleen are doing so much for so many people, and the best I can do is provide the Web space and try to follow in your footsteps.

If it's too personal, please don't feel like you have to answer, but can I ask: where is your son? My brother is at Jessup, but he spent some time at Hagerstown, too.
